title: System Utilities Module
summary: This module provides utility functions for querying system-level information, specifically focusing on device memory statistics on Windows platforms. It acts as an interface to retrieve hardware-related data.

nodes.label: Query Device Memory
nodes.title: Query Device Memory (Windows)
nodes.description: Retrieves available and total memory for a specified GPU device using DXGI and PDH APIs on Windows. Currently returns a placeholder value, indicating potential future implementation or platform-specific limitations.

nodes.label: Windows System APIs
nodes.title: Windows OS APIs (DXGI, PDH)
nodes.description: Represents the underlying Windows operating system APIs, such as DXGI (DirectX Graphics Infrastructure) and PDH (Performance Data Helper), used to query hardware and performance information.

groups.label: System Information Retrieval
groups.title: System Information Retrieval
groups.description: Encapsulates functions responsible for gathering system-level hardware and performance data, particularly for device memory.
